env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd probe
! logos lint ./alias
stderr 'alias.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[correctness::unclosed_io_closer\]'
! logos lint ./chain
stderr 'chain.go:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[correctness::unclosed_io_closer\]'
logos lint ./closed
! stderr .
logos lint ./transfer
! stderr .

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/closeralias

go 1.27
-- probe/alias/alias.go --
package alias

import "os"

func Open(path string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil { return err }
	c := f
	_ = c
	return nil
}
-- probe/chain/chain.go --
package chain

import "os"

func Open(path string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil { return err }
	c := f
	d := c
	_ = d
	return nil
}
-- probe/closed/closed.go --
package closed

import "os"

func Open(path string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil { return err }
	defer func() {
		if err := f.Close(); err != nil { panic(err) }
	}()
	c := f
	_ = c
	return nil
}
-- probe/transfer/transfer.go --
package transfer

import "os"

func Open(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil { return nil, err }
	c := f
	return c, nil
}
